title: Patient history scope isolation & citation rules

test_cases.name: Patient history isolation to reasoning
test_cases.input_setup: Compare extraction prompt and diagnosis prompt with patient history text
test_cases.expected_result: History is present in reasoning prompt; strictly absent in extraction prompt
test_cases.evidence: Data flow verified: patient history isolated strictly to diagnosis/reasoning prompt

test_cases.name: History citation requirement in prompt
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect diagnosis prompt instructions for history handling
test_cases.expected_result: Mandates explicit history_considered and history_notes citations
test_cases.evidence: Prompt enforces history consideration citation and rationale

test_cases.name: Evidence link verification
test_cases.input_setup: Instantiate DiagnosisOutput with specific blood pressure finding citation
test_cases.expected_result: Evidence documented and retrievable in history_notes
test_cases.evidence: Evidence link between clinical findings and diagnosis validated

test_cases.name: History contradiction detection
test_cases.input_setup: Cross-check note denying diabetes against history containing Type 2 DM
test_cases.expected_result: Contradiction flagged in history validation check

test_cases.name: Citation verbatim accuracy
test_cases.input_setup: Validate extracted citation against source transcript
test_cases.expected_result: Citation matches verbatim substring of source narrative
test_cases.evidence: Citation verified as an exact verbatim substring of the source narrative
